app.title: Canada Post Claim Runner
app.subtitle: Import history, identify late-delivery candidates, and submit selected candidates in one place.
setup.title: Welcome — readiness setup
setup.intro: Canada Post Claim Runner keeps credentials and browser sessions on this device. It will not test your account or submit anything during setup.
history.title: History, Recovery & Maintenance
tracking.credentials.clearConfirm: Clear the current Tracking API client ID and client secret from encrypted storage? Website credentials will not be changed.
tracking.credentials.clearComplete: Tracking API credentials and the diagnostic gate were cleared. Website credentials were not changed.
reason.POSSIBLE_EXCLUSION: A possible guarantee exclusion requires human review.
reason.UNKNOWN_SERVICE: The service could not be mapped to a verified guarantee rule.
reason.POLICY_COVERAGE_MISSING: Verified policy or holiday coverage does not include this date.
reason.DEADLINE_EXPIRED: The claim submission deadline has expired.
step2.candidateExplanation: This step compares the successful-delivery date against the original Delivery Standard. A shipment becomes a late-delivery candidate when successful delivery occurred after that standard. First-attempt, service, policy, and claim-window information remains advisory. Canada Post makes the final eligibility decision.
step2.runCompleteCandidates: The database candidate queue was promoted and claims.csv was refreshed as a human-readable export.

step2.diagnostic.message: Exactly one authorized shipment will be queried. This does not modify claim state or start the bulk queue.

step2.diagnostic.noUsableRow: No usable tracking row is available.

step3.loadFailed: Could not load the database candidate queue.

step3.zeroSelectionRecovery: Select at least one late-delivery candidate before starting a dry or live run.

privacy.title: Data Management / Privacy
privacy.intro: Preview and remove application data by tracking number, date range, or all records. Duplicate-submission protection is retained only as non-identifying hashes and terminal outcomes.
privacy.trackingLabel: Tracking numbers (separated by spaces, commas, or new lines)
privacy.destructiveConfirm: I understand this removes the selected personal and shipment data from this application.
privacy.typedPhraseLabel: Type the displayed confirmation phrase exactly
privacy.secondConfirm: Confirm again that all application data should be deleted.
privacy.externalCopies: External exports and backups are separate copies. The operator is responsible for deleting external copies. Encrypted backups may still contain previously exported data. Deletion from this application does not delete Canada Post’s records.

privacy.deleteFailed: The selected data could not be deleted.
